description:
**Extended Term Temporary**


**Job \#:** req38411
  

**Organization:** World Bank
  

**Sector:** Finance \& Accounting
  

**Grade:** ET4
  

**Term Duration:** 0 years 8 months  


**Recruitment Type:** Local Recruitment
  

**Location:** Chennai,India
  

**Required Language(s):** English
  

**Preferred Language(s):**
  

**Closing Date:** 10/6/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  

**Description**



At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https:// www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd

**Unit Context:**  

CTRTA is responsible for accounts payable, fixed assets and lease accounting, quality assurance (QA) program, travel accounting, sanctions screening and SAP security oversight. It also provides strategic leadership and guidance to business units across the WBG on developing and maintaining an effective system of internal controls over these functions.


The QA Program assesses the WBG Units’ compliance with administrative expense policies and procedures and recommends corrective actions as appropriate. In collaboration with the Units and stakeholders, the program monitors compliance and strengthens internal controls by building awareness of compliance trends and exceptions. It identifies opportunities to strengthen controls and simplify processes through behavioral, policy, process and system changes. It also provides a basis for management’s annual assertions regarding controls over administrative expenses.  

The Quality Assurance unit (CTRQA) located in Chennai, India, functionally reports to CTRTA and supports CTRTA in the effective delivery of the QA Program. CTRQA is currently seeking an Extended Term Temporary based in Chennai, India, reporting to the Team Lead. Primary area of responsibility is to ensure best\-in\-class service delivery for the QA program.  

  

**What you will do:**  

**Quality Assurance Reviews:**  

* Review of the WBG’s administrative and capital expense transactions to verify accuracy of records, compliance with Bank’s policies and procedures.
* Assess controls relating to WBG country offices by conducting country office deep dive reviews.
* Follow\-up with the units on appropriate and timely submission of documentation and clarifications for review.

**Accounting:**  

* As part of the Accounting and Reporting job stream, you will prepare trial balance reports covering administrative expense ledger accounts and provide appropriate analyses of expenses, coordinate with the Analyst and TL for sign\-off to the reporting units.

  

**Financial Analysis:**  

* Identify themes, trends, and emerging risks as part of continuous monitoring activities and support the visualization, presentation of the analyses.
* Perform ad hoc analytics requests.

**Selection Criteria**


**Attention:** "Preference will be given to local talent, that is, applicants that are authorized to work in the duty station for any employer. Internal applicants may apply per existing guidelines."  

  

**What you will bring:**  

  

Education:  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (Ex. Finance, Accounting, Taxation)
* CA, CPA or equivalent designation is preferred.

  

Experience:  

* 2 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience

  

Knowledge and Skills:  

* Good understanding of generally accepted accounting principles, accounting controls over accounting processes and financial reporting operations; familiarity with generally accepted auditing standards in these areas.
* Strong analytical skills with ability to collate, organize and interpret data, assess issues, develop sound conclusions, formulate remedial measures with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Windows applications, namely Excel, Word and Power Point, including advanced spreadsheet design, manipulation, and analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, or similar data analytics and automation tools is an added advantage.

  

Abilities:  

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain and express views/opinions clearly and confidently
* Ability to deal sensitively in a multi\-cultural environment and build effective working relations with clients and colleagues
* Exhibit a personality that enables the incumbent to be client focused, flexible and an excellent team player. Ability to effectively work with other staff in the department and elsewhere in the Bank.
* Self\-motivated person with high degree of initiative and a strong team player.
 **WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results..


World Bank Group Core Competencies

*As per WBG policy, an Extended Term (ET) appointment is subject to a lifetime maximum of three (3\) years. Former and current ET staff who have completed or are in the process of completing their third\-year ET appointment are not eligible for future ET appointments.*

*We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.*

*Learn more about working at the* *World Bank* *and* *IFC* *including our values and inspiring stories.*

title: Senior Analyst - Applications Programming
description:
**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  

  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  

  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  

  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!  

  



**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**
  

Global Information Security (GIS) – Cyber Security Technology, Identity \& Authentication Services (GIS CST – IAS) team is responsible for defining, documenting, and publicizing strategic roadmap for various Identity and Access Management technology stacks for Bank of America. The team looks into the industry best practices in IAM area and works to align them to enterprise needs.

  



**Job Description**


This role involves specialization in Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies with deeper understanding of SSO and authentication, directory services, . The individual must be able to meet demands of working across multiple work streams, communicate effectively with senior technology leaders and business partners. Organized evidence of compliance and producing documentation will also be key to this role. Tight coordination with the infrastructure technology organization will also be required.


**Responsibilities**


* Create SSO policies as per business requirements
* Troubleshoot SSO related issues while onboarding the enterprise applications
* Responsible to do a deep dive research, analysis, and resolution of issues
* Work closely with Business \& Technical analysts to implement enhancements and new Integrations
* Responsible for assisting users and application teams to resolve system/ business process questions and issues related to specific applications such as web services, Unix, Core Java, LDAP etc
* Responsible for tracking issues \& tasks in ReqIT/Jira by following documented process and procedures and meeting service level agreements
* Responsible for developing custom solutions in Ping Federate, Ping Access
* Bridge the gap between SSO teams designing solutions and business partners to fully understand and desgin authentication solutions as per their requirements
* Document the solution use cases, process improvement and SSO configuration modernization

  

**Requirements**


Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field


Certifications If Any : NA


Experience Range : 7\+ years

  



**Foundational skills**


* Experience of Ping Access (SSO) \& Ping Federate
* Knowledge on LDAP, SAML, OAuth2\.0/ OIDC protocols and frameworks
* Knowledge on Multifactror Authentication/ FIDO
* Analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent oral/written communication skills

  



**Desired skills**


* Basic networking concepts and knowledge on firewall and load balancer
* Basic knowledge if RHEL and Windows Server OS
* Basic knowledge of apache and IIS server configuration

  

**Work Timings :** 1\.30pm to 10\.30 pm

  



**Job Location :** Chennai/Hyderabad

description:
Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Position: Lead Analyst/ Associate Consultant\-Power BI with paginated reports  

Experience: 8\-12 years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift Timing: 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM  

Location: Chennai  

Position ID: J0326\-2348  

Employment Type: Full Time  

  

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 8 years of relevant experience.  

  

We are seeking a hands\-on Enterprise Power BI Architect to define, design, and govern the BI architecture across programs and client accounts. This role focuses on building scalable, secure, and high\-performance reporting solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making.  

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and delivery leads to translate business needs into enterprise reporting frameworks. The role requires a strong combination of Power BI technical expertise, architectural thinking, governance, and stakeholder engagement.  

This is an individual contributor role focused on architecture and delivery oversight, rather than people management.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


Architecture \& Solution Design  

Design, develop, and oversee Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports aligned with business requirements.  

Define and maintain enterprise\-level Power BI architecture standards, patterns, and best practices.  

Architect scalable semantic models, reusable data models, and enterprise reporting frameworks.  

Establish reusable data models, KPI frameworks, and visualization standards across domains.  

Define and enforce data security strategies, including Row\-Level Security (RLS), access governance, and workspace security.  

Drive performance optimization across datasets, data models, reports, and enterprise workspaces.  

Optimize data models, datasets, and report performance for enterprise\-scale deployments.  

Governance \& Strategy  

Define and enforce BI governance standards including naming conventions, workspace strategy, and deployment pipelines.  

Collaborate with data engineering teams to align reporting with data warehouse, lakehouse, and analytics platforms.  

Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend modernization and architecture improvements.  

Ensure data governance, compliance, and security standards are maintained.  

Act as a steward for analytics platform maturity and standardization across accounts.  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership  

Lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, program leaders, and clients.  

Translate business strategy and analytical needs into actionable reporting and architecture roadmaps.  

Clearly articulate trade\-offs, risks, scalability considerations, and remediation strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.  

Provide solution architecture support for presales, estimations, and strategic initiatives.  

Delivery Enablement \& Team Leadership  

Guide BI developers and tech leads on data modeling, DAX optimization, and Power BI best practices.  

Conduct architecture reviews, design validations, and solution quality assessments.  

Enable DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and monitoring practices for Power BI solutions.  

Mentor teams and promote enterprise BI delivery maturity and technical excellence.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Must\-Have Skills  

8\+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data Analytics.  

5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI experience in enterprise environments.  

Design, develop, and oversee interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports.  

Strong expertise in:  

Advanced data modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Composite Models)  

DAX optimization and performance tuning  

Power Query / data transformation  

Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Power BI governance  

Strong SQL skills with understanding of data warehouse architecture.  

Experience with Azure / SQL Server\-based analytics platforms.  

Experience implementing DevOps / CI\-CD pipelines for Power BI.  

Strong stakeholder communication and architectural leadership capabilities.  

  

Good to Have  

Experience with Microsoft Fabric.  

Exposure to data lakes, lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.  

Experience implementing monitoring, observability, and automation frameworks for BI solutions.  

Experience working in large\-scale or multi\-account delivery environments.

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Job title:** Network Security Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** Mgr, IT Systems Administration**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time **Purpose of the Role**
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for securing the enterprise network infrastructure through vulnerability management, security automation, and network segmentation initiatives. This role partners closely with Infrastructure, Information Security, OT Engineering, Cloud, and Operations teams to identify and remediate security risks, automate security controls, and design network architectures that reduce attack surfaces while supporting business operations.  

The ideal candidate combines strong networking expertise with cybersecurity knowledge and automation skills. Success in this role requires the ability to manage vulnerability remediation programs, implement network segmentation strategies across IT and OT environments, and develop automation solutions that improve security posture and operational efficiency. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Vulnerability Management**  

* Lead network vulnerability management activities across routers, switches, firewalls, SD\-WAN, wireless, and cloud networking platforms.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results of network assets from platforms such as Qualys and other assessment tools.
* Prioritize and develop remediation efforts based on risk, exploitability, business impact, and asset criticality.
* Track SLA compliance, exception management, and risk acceptance for network devices and establish related vulnerability reporting and KPI metrics.
* Identify recurring vulnerability trends and implement long\-term corrective actions.
 **Security Automation**  

* Design and develop automation solutions for network monitoring, configuration validation, vulnerability remediation.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks utilizing Ansible, Python, PowerShell, APIs, and orchestration platforms.
* Automate firewall policy reviews, rule lifecycle management, and security configuration validation.
* Implement automated compliance checks aligned with network security standards and hardening baselines.
* Develop integrations between vulnerability management tools, CMDB platforms, ticketing systems, and monitoring solutions.
* Reduce manual operational effort through repeatable, scalable automation workflows.
 **Network Segmentation \& Security Engineering**  

* Implement and maintain secure network segmentation architectures and standards for enterprise, cloud, datacenter, edge sites, and operational technology (OT) environments.
* Define firewall zoning strategies, security policies, and access control standards.

title: Director, Cybersecurity
description:
**Job Summary**

Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
IFF is a global leader in Flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health \& biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.


Digital Technology Solutions: Accelerating innovation through data, technology and digital transformation, building intelligent solutions that enhance experiences and power smarter decisions.


The Director, Cybersecurity Architecture leads the strategy, design, and engineering of security across three critical domains for IFF: Infrastructure Security, Operational Technology (OT) Security, and Vulnerability Management. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer, this Director is a senior leader within the Cybersecurity, Risk \& Compliance organization and is accountable for the architecture and technical controls that protect IFF's enterprise infrastructure and manufacturing environments, and for the enterprise vulnerability management program, globally.


The role is based in Chennai, India. Be part of a creative, solution\-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.


**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

**Infrastructure Security:**

* Own the security architecture for IFF's enterprise infrastructure — network, cloud (multi\-cloud / hybrid), endpoint, identity, and data center environments.
* Define and maintain security reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that embed zero\-trust principles and defense\-in\-depth across the estate.
* Lead the engineering and lifecycle of core security controls (e.g., network segmentation, firewalls, secure connectivity, cloud security posture, privileged access, and endpoint protection).
* Partner with infrastructure, cloud, and platform teams to secure new and existing services, ensuring security requirements are integrated into design and deployment.
* Drive continuous improvement of the control environment based on threat intelligence, assessments, and audit and regulatory findings.

**OT Security:**

* Lead the security strategy and architecture for Operational Technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS/SCADA), and plant\-floor networks across IFF's global manufacturing sites.
* Establish and govern IT/OT convergence security standards, network segmentation, and secure remote access for plant environments.
* Build and maintain OT asset visibility, threat detection, and vulnerability management capabilities in partnership with plant operations and engineering teams.
* Align OT security to recognized frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST CSF) and embed safety\- and availability\-aware controls suited to production environments.
* Partner with site leadership to drive OT security awareness, incident readiness, and resilience across manufacturing operations.

**Vulnerability Management:**

* Own the enterprise vulnerability management program — the strategy, architecture, and operating model for continuous identification, prioritization, and remediation of vulnerabilities across infrastructure, cloud, endpoints, and applications.
* Define risk\-based prioritization standards — leveraging CVSS, EPSS, threat intelligence, and asset criticality — to focus remediation on the exposures that pose the greatest risk to IFF.
* Lead the engineering and lifecycle of vulnerability scanning, attack surface management, and remediation\-tracking capabilities, with clear service\-level targets and metrics.
* Partner with infrastructure, cloud, application, and plant operations teams to drive timely remediation and to embed vulnerability management into build\-and\-operate processes.
* Report on vulnerability posture, remediation performance, and risk reduction to the CISO, DTS leadership, and governance and audit stakeholders.

**Leadership \& Strategy:**

* Lead, develop, and grow a globally distributed team of security architects, engineers, and specialist partners; set direction, priorities, and performance standards.
* Translate enterprise and manufacturing risk into a clear, multi\-year security architecture roadmap aligned to IFF's business strategy.
* Serve as a senior advisor to the CISO and to DTS and business leaders on infrastructure, OT, and vulnerability management risk and investment.
* Manage budget, vendors, and strategic partners for the architecture domains, ensuring value, quality, and delivery.
* Champion a security\-by\-design culture and represent Cybersecurity Architecture in governance, audit, and regulatory engagements.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12\+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience with deep expertise in security architecture and engineering, including 5\+ years of experience leading technical teams across globally distributed and remote environments.
* Expertise in infrastructure security, OT/ICS security, and vulnerability management, with advanced knowledge in at least two of these domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud security (Azure and/or AWS), network security, identity and access management, and zero\-trust architectures.
* Experience designing, implementing, and aligning security programs with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and IEC 62443\.
* Proven ability to communicate complex security risks to technical and non\-technical audiences and influence stakeholders across a global, matrixed organization.
* Experience securing OT environments within manufacturing, chemical, process industry, or similar operational settings.
* Hands\-on experience leading enterprise vulnerability management or attack surface management programs.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SABSA, GICSP, or Azure/AWS Security certifications, and/or experience working within a regulated multinational organization.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Proven success leading globally distributed cybersecurity teams.
* Deep expertise in designing secure architectures for complex enterprise and manufacturing environments.
* Ability to translate business and operational risks into pragmatic security solutions.
* Strong executive presence with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving security\-by\-design practices.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Work in a global organization that values innovation and sustainability.
* Hybrid work model offering flexibility and balance.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity \& expression, sexual orientation, or disability.


Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace\-diversity\-and\-inclusion to learn more
